goal: Ship v1 city outlook: a user picks a South Florida city and sees the flood prognosis (Low/Elevated/High/Severe) with reasons and the beach-day score (0-100), installable and usable offline with stale-data labels.
acceptance: City picker lists the starter cities from public/data/cities.json and remembers the last choice
Outlook shows flood level with reasons and beach score with label, from live Open-Meteo + NOAA + NWS data called by the browser
Active NWS flood/coastal alert overrides the computed level and is shown first
Not-an-official-warning notice and 'Weather data by Open-Meteo.com' credit are visible
Works offline with last cached data and its age shown
Unit, fixture, e2e and accessibility checks pass on the deploy preview

brief.goal: Write the contracts between src/api, src/scoring and src/ui for the outlook: function names, input/output JSON shapes (normalised weather, tides, alerts, FloodResult, BeachResult), error/missing-data rules, cache keys.
acceptance: Two experts can build a client and a scorer from the spec without talking
No server, database or secret introduced
